2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000030_KOANA
2.description: Where's Lamaty'i? What happened inside the dome?

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000050_KOANA
4.description: Yet the danger remains, and you must soon sally forth unto an unknown reality...

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000080_WUKLAMAT
7.description: This is Zoraal Ja's son, Gulool Ja.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000090_KOANA
8.description: I see. Time did flow differently inside the dome.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000100_KOANA
9.description: If he is our brother's child, then...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000110_KOANA
10.description: Gulool Ja, was it? My name is Koana, and I am Lamaty'i's brother.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000130_WUKLAMAT
12.description: You'll find none more dependable than Koana. He's family, and he'll take good care of you.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000140_KOANA
13.description: A pleasure to meet you, Gulool Ja.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000150_GULOOLJA
14.description: A pleasure to meet you too, uh...Uncle Koana.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000160_KOANA
15.description: Well, I suppose I <hex:021A020203>am<hex:021A020103> your uncle...

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000170_WUKLAMAT
17.description: You're all confused, and little wonder. Rest assured all will be explained in due course.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000180_WUKLAMAT
18.description: But for now, I want to make one thing clear.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000190_WUKLAMAT
19.description: Gulool Ja is his own person. He had no part in his father's crimes.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000200_WUKLAMAT
20.description: If you have anger towards Zoraal Ja you need to express, Koana and I will gladly hear you. But you will treat Gulool Ja as you would any child─with kindness.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000210_TULIYOLLALMALE
21.description: As we should. The boy's done no wrong.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000220_TULIYOLLALFEMALE
22.description: Yes, the Vow of Resolve speaks true!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000230_KOANA
23.description: So...will you tell me what happened? G'raha Tia has given me a summary, but I would hear your detailed accounts.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000240_WUKLAMAT
24.description: Can we walk while we chat? I want to see how things are in the city.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000250_KOANA
25.description: In that case, let us make our way to Brightploom Post.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000260_KOANA
26.description: Our soldiers remain on high alert, but if the threat of invasion has passed, I will bid them take a well-earned rest.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000270_YSHTOLA
27.description: Electrope everywhere one turns, harboring vast amounts of lightning... This place is very much alive.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000280_YSHTOLA
28.description: Krile, try holding your earring to the terminal.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000300_SHALE
30.description: Don't give up yet. The terminal reads the code─it might just need higher clearance.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000310_SHALE
31.description: Gulool Ja, would you give it a try?

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000330_SHALE
33.description: If the king's authority has passed to you, then the gate ought to open.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000331_ZORAALJA
34.description: (-Zoraal Ja-)But I leave behind that which I've gained by the sweat of my brow... It is yours to embrace...or spurn...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000360_YSHTOLA
37.description: Remarkable... A voidgate is forced open with a blast of aether, and thus appears as a tear in the fabric of reality.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000370_YSHTOLA
38.description: In contrast, this is the stitchwork of a master. Neatly hemmed, without a thread out of place. A power to be reckoned with...

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000380_YSHTOLA
39.description: But now isn't the time to marvel. If Gulool Ja can open the gate, then so too can Sphene close it.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000390_YSHTOLA
40.description: 'Twould be wise to employ magicks in its defense─both to maintain its stability and ward off interference.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000391_YSHTOLA
41.description: While I am able to invoke said magicks, I cannot sustain them alone. I require another to channel with me, and in unison.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000392_URIANGER
42.description: For that role I do humbly volunteer myself, but even our combined efforts offer no certainty of success. Might we prevail upon the two of you to lend your support?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000393_ALPHINAUD
43.description: Of course. If coordination between mages is required, few would be better suited than Alisaie and myself.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000395_YSHTOLA
45.description: While your presence would be welcome, I'd rather you joined the expedition team.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000396_YSHTOLA
46.description: For despite our earnest efforts, the gate may well end up closed once more.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000397_YSHTOLA
47.description: In such a situation, it may fall to those on the other side to devise a method to reconnect our worlds. A task with which you are not unfamiliar, as I recall?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000398_GRAHATIA
48.description: I have faith it will not come to that, but should it, I will endeavor not to disappoint.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000510_THANCRED
58.description: So, assuming Wuk Lamat, Krile, and Erenville are a given for this foray...

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000511_THANCRED
59.description: I'll make myself useful here by guarding those who are maintaining the gate.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000512_THANCRED
60.description: Should any threats emerge, from the world beyond or otherwise, I'll deal with them.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000521_ESTINIEN
62.description: Which leaves you free to head in there─and do what you do best.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
64.description: With you holding the fort, I know we'll be all right.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
65.description: Make sure we can return while we're still young and beautiful, eh?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000531_ALISAIE
68.description: Just don't let <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> bear the burden alone, do you hear?

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000533_ALISAIE
70.description: We'll protect the portal. Keep it open no matter what.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000550_YSHTOLA
72.description: Short of asking an Ascian, we unfortunately have no way of identifying which one it is.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000551_WUKLAMAT
73.description: Well, what we do know is that it's Sphene's domain─a place where she brings back those who've been lost. So for now, why don't we call it...

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000580_ERENVILLE
77.description: How to describe the sheer amazement we felt when we emerged on the other side of the portal?<hex:02100103>I fear words do not do it justice.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000590_ERENVILLE
78.description: Before us was a vibrant world where the memories of the departed abided and reveled in bygone days.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000591_ERENVILLE
79.description: Living Memory, or so the Endless called it.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000600_ERENVILLE
80.description: How they laughed and smiled as they reminisced upon unfulfilled dreams. Alive in all perceivable ways...yet knowing no loss.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000610_ERENVILLE
81.description: So resplendent was every ilm of this paradise, the words rose unbidden to my lips:

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000620_ERENVILLE
82.description: All this time, it was here─the city of gold.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000640_WUKLAMAT
84.description: If you are, say something! We need to talk!

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000660_SPHENE
86.description: Hmm... That you should come here...

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000670_WUKLAMAT
87.description: I haven't known you long, Sphene, but I know you have a good heart. Your love for your people is proof of this.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000680_WUKLAMAT
88.description: I can't let you do what you're trying to do. And deep down, I don't think you want to do it either.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000690_SPHENE
89.description: I want a world without suffering. A world where nothing is lost... Would that such a place existed.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000700_SPHENE
90.description: But the Endless only grow in number, and ever more life force is needed to sustain them.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000710_SPHENE
91.description: Within the barrier, we have managed to curb the cycle of rebirth these few hundred years. But we've reached the limit.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000720_SPHENE
92.description: That is why I looked to interdimensional fusion. To harvest what we needed from your world.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000721_SPHENE
93.description: From your people. And with the key, we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> have it.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000730_GRAHATIA
94.description: And once you've plundered our world of aether, what then? Will you do the same to others?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000731_GRAHATIA
95.description: All men eventually die. If you make Endless of everyone, you will never have enough aether to sustain them. You but prolong the inevitable.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000740_KRILE
96.description: Sphene. If you would nevertheless persist in this folly, we must stand against you.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000750_KRILE
97.description: For we too have people we cannot lose. Places to which our hearts belong.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000760_SPHENE
98.description: Lamaty'i... I would have loved nothing more than to work hand in hand with you to tend our nations.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000770_SPHENE
99.description: But fate is cruel. By the time it had brought us together, our futures had already been written.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000780_SPHENE
100.description: The kind and gentle Queen Sphene was too weak to serve her people. And so she will serve them no more.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000790_SPHENE
101.description: I will erase all memories of the living Sphene─she who has cursed me with this soft and powerless nature.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000800_SPHENE
102.description: Freed from conscience, I shall become a ruler that <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> protect Alexandria. A devourer of worlds.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000810_SPHENE
103.description: When two nations cannot protect their own without doing harm to the other, there can be only one resolution. It is a hard truth...but one <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> understand, don't you?

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
109.description: I'll protect my world and all the others.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
110.description: This evil is not inevitable! Find another way!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000870_SPHENE
113.description: I'm afraid we're out of time. The process has begun. And it cannot be stopped.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000880_MESOTERMINAL
114.description: (-Meso Terminal-)Meso Terminal memory deletion in progress.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000890_MESOTERMINAL
115.description: (-Meso Terminal-)Meso Terminal memory deletion in progress. Upon completion, interdimensional fusion will commence.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000910_GRAHATIA
117.description: Do you remember what I said to you before all this?

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000920_GRAHATIA
118.description: That life is a series of journeys. That you must be true to yourself, for indeed, there's no telling what awaits.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000930_GRAHATIA
119.description: I don't know about you, but I certainly didn't expect to behold such sights. The future is as fluid as the water beneath us, truly.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000940_GRAHATIA
120.description: Tell me, my friend. Have you ever wished to be reunited with someone who has passed away?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000950_GRAHATIA
121.description: I have. I do. But I think... Above all else, I wish that they had lived.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000960_GRAHATIA
122.description: If only for one more day. One more day... A joyous one, if I could choose.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000970_GRAHATIA
123.description: I did all that I could to make it happen. I tried everything. Spared nothing.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000980_GRAHATIA
124.description: In that manner, I was able to keep some few souls out of harm's way. But so, so many were beyond my power to save.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000981_GRAHATIA
125.description: What would I have done then, had I <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103>...?

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000982_GRAHATIA
126.description: And you─can you imagine yourself spending eternity here, knowing no loss?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_000990_WUKLAMAT
127.description: We've switched on the circuits like you asked.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001000_CAHCIUA
128.description: Thank you, everyone. Hopefully this does the trick.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001070_CAHCIUA
135.description: I've never seen anything like it.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001110_NAMIKKA
139.description: Begging your pardon, but I'm looking for a child─a small Xbr'aal girl. Have you seen her by chance?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001130_WUKLAMAT
141.description: It's me, Wuk Lamat. Don't you recognize me?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001140_NAMIKKA
142.description: Oh, what am I to do? The child and I, we aren't related by blood, but she's as dear to me as my own...

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001150_WUKLAMAT
143.description: It's all right. You've found her. I'm here.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001170_WUKLAMAT
145.description: Yes, Namikka. You know these eyes, this voice. It's me, Wuk Lamat.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001180_NAMIKKA
147.description: It <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> you! How silly of me. But if you're here, then that means...

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001200_NAMIKKA
150.description: Good, good... Thank the gods for that...

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001210_NAMIKKA
151.description: But what power has brought us together again? This isn't a dream, is it?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001221_WUKLAMAT
153.description: Or rather, it is a dream come true. I so wanted to hear your voice one more time.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001230_NAMIKKA
154.description: Just look at you. My Wuk Lamat. Stronger and more assured than I've ever seen.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001240_NAMIKKA
155.description: Such hazards you must have braved and hardships endured to come so far...

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001241_WUKLAMAT
156.description: It was tough, but I made it thanks to my friends.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001270_WUKLAMAT
159.description: I'm the person I am now because you always believed in me. Because you loved me as if I were your own daughter.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001280_WUKLAMAT
160.description: Thank you, thank you. You're everything I could've asked for─the <hex:021A020203>best<hex:021A020103> mother!

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001300_NAMIKKA
162.description: Looking back, I've had a blessed life. And it was because I was a part of yours.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001310_NAMIKKA
163.description: When I lost my child to illness, I thought I'd never know happiness again. But it rekindled in my breast the instant you smiled your little smile at me. You became my purpose. My joy.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001330_NAMIKKA
165.description: To have this chance to speak with you again and leave nothing unsaid... I know not how or why, but I am grateful. So grateful.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001340_NAMIKKA
166.description: Where you must go, I cannot follow, but know that I'll always be with you. Take care of yourself. Promise me.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001360_WUKLAMAT
169.description: I understand why Sphene cannot bear to let them go.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001370_WUKLAMAT
170.description: But as painful as it is to part...

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001380_WUKLAMAT
171.description: We're meant to live and die. To let go and let others carry on in our stead. We can't cling to everything forever.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001410_OTIS
174.description: (-Old-fashioned Knight-)I know not who you are, but my thanks for your timely aid!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001430_YESTERLANDBOY
176.description: That was amazing, Otis! And you too, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>!

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001440_OTIS
177.description: Hahaha! Fiends such as these are naught to be feared.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001450_WUKLAMAT
178.description: Well then... Dealt with it already, have you?

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001460_OTIS
179.description: Be at ease, one and all. So long as I, Ser Otis, live and breathe, no citizen shall come to harm!

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001480_WUKLAMAT
181.description: Of all the people─could you really be <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> Otis?

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001490_OTIS
182.description: I'm certain I do not know what you mean by <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> Otis. I am who I am─and I should very much like to know who <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> are.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001500_WUKLAMAT
183.description: You're Ser Otis Velona, lord captain of the royal knights of Alexandria, yes? We met you while searching for Gulool Ja.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001510_WUKLAMAT
184.description: You cooked a most delicious repast for us. Fought beside us in Solution Nine.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001520_OTIS
185.description: Gulool Ja...? Solution Nine...? I've never heard of such things.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001530_OTIS
186.description: These events of which you speak are utterly unknown to me. As are you─I'm quite confident I would recall if we had met before!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001540_OTIS
187.description: Could this be... <gasp> Villainy!? You seek to bewilder me for purposes most foul!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001550_WUKLAMAT
188.description: No, no! No villainy intended, I swear!

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001560_WUKLAMAT
189.description: (Tell me I'm not mad. This is definitely the Otis we know...right?)

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
192.description: An earlier version─he won't remember his time as a machine.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001570_OTIS
193.description: I say, what are you whispering about there!?

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001580_OTIS
194.description: Wait─I've no time for this! I must attend to my preparations for the Founding Celebration.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001590_OTIS
195.description: The children begged and begged that I perform in the marquee play, and I cannot possibly disappoint them!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001600_OTIS
196.description: I take my leave of you. Good day!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001620_KRILE
198.description: Well, this seems to be the right place. What's on the program, I wonder.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001630_GRAHATIA
199.description: And where are the others, for that matter...

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001640_YESTERLANDTROUPE
200.description: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! Tonight's performance is a story that takes place long, long ago.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001650_YESTERLANDTROUPE
201.description: A great conflict rages over precious electrope, and the Kingdom of Alexandria has been embroiled in the chaos.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001660_YESTERLANDTROUPE
202.description: When the royal capital comes under siege, the kingdom's valiant knights lay their lives on the line for their beloved Princess Sphene.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001670_YESTERLANDTROUPE
203.description: I bid you keep your handkerchiefs at hand. Now, without further ado...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001770_QUEENACTOR
213.description: You must flee, all of you!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001810_QUEENACTOR
217.description: I am thanks to you, my dearest Otis!

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001830_YESTERLANDTROUPE
219.description: And so, in no small part due to the valor of the royal knights, the kingdom succeeds in repelling the invaders.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001850_YESTERLANDTROUPE
221.description: For in mad defiance, the enemy unleashes a forbidden weapon which brings about a terrible calamity. Full many lose their lives...

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001860_YESTERLANDTROUPE
222.description: The good Queen Sphene, shining vision of hope, among them...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001870_YESTERLANDTROUPE
223.description: (Go to her! You're supposed to go to her!)

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001910_WUKLAMAT
227.description: And then...though the people grieved their queen's tragic passing, guided by her legacy of compassion...

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001920_WUKLAMAT
228.description: Oh boy. They, um...worked hand in hand to overcome an age of hardship, and in time...they built a peaceful and prosperous Alexandria─a <hex:021A020203>new<hex:021A020103> Alexandria!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001930_OTIS
229.description: Pray forgive me... The memories...they had me in a vice grip...

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001940_WUKLAMAT
230.description: All's well that ends well. I wouldn't dwell on it.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001950_OTIS
231.description: If I may ask... During your improvisation, you spoke of a <hex:021A020203>new<hex:021A020103> Alexandria.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001960_OTIS
232.description: And so I am given to wonder... Do you hail from a time after mine own?

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001970_WUKLAMAT
233.description: We do. And we're living people, not Endless.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001980_OTIS
234.description: My word. That I should meet the living in this place...

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_001990_OTIS
235.description: There is another question I dread to speak aloud. A question I couldn't bring myself to pose to newcomers out of fear of the truth...

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002010_WUKLAMAT
237.description: It does. It isn't quite the place you knew, but it endures.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002020_WUKLAMAT
238.description: The descendants of your people walk its streets and live each day to the fullest as proud Alexandrians.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002040_OTIS
240.description: I-I had failed to protect my queen, but to hear that... It brings me a measure of peace.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002050_WUKLAMAT
241.description: You were there too, Otis. That is, an incarnation of you.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002070_OTIS
243.description: But wait... Something comes back to me. When they were researching a means to resurrect Her Majesty─memory preservation or some such─I volunteered to be a test subject...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002080_OTIS
244.description: ...No, it is a fog I cannot pierce. But pray tell me, this incarnation of myself─what was he like?

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
246.description: He was a proud and valiant knight of the realm.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
247.description: He was a brave soul who protected his queen to the last.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002090_WUKLAMAT
248.description: That's not all. He was a father in all but name to the new king, Gulool Ja.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002100_WUKLAMAT
249.description: Whatever you may have failed to do, you're the noblest of souls, Otis. And your deeds─your sacrifice─gave us hope that we sorely needed.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002120_OTIS
251.description: 'Tis a miracle. Verily, there can be no other way to describe it.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002130_WUKLAMAT
252.description: It is. It really is. We bear the legacy of your other self, and we'd be glad to bear yours as well.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002140_OTIS
253.description: My, what comfort you offer! With such dependable souls to take up my shield, I may rest easy indeed!

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002150_OTIS
254.description: I beg you, watch over our new king.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002151_OTIS
255.description: The war changed my queen. To her final moment, grief darkened her gentle countenance.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002152_OTIS
256.description: I've not the honor of knowing Gulool Ja, but I pray, that for all his days, he shall have cause to smile.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002160_WUKLAMAT
257.description: We'll see to it he does, Otis. I swear.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002170_CAHCIUA
258.description: That knight─he was the one who looked after Gulool Ja...

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002180_CAHCIUA
259.description: And now you follow in his footsteps.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002190_WUKLAMAT
260.description: And those of others as well.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002200_WUKLAMAT
261.description: We've come to know how much Sphene's people loved her. How much they yearned for peace. All of this, we'll carry with us.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002220_KRILE
263.description: That rather resembles arcanima, wouldn't you agree?

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002230_GRAHATIA
264.description: Indeed. While similar arts could have developed independently across reflections, this verges on being identical.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002260_ALAYLA
267.description: (-Milalla Woman-)Do we know each other from somewhere?

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002280_ALAYLA
269.description: (-Milalla Woman-)I'm sorry, but I must be going.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002301_ALAYLA
273.description: (-Milalla Woman-)You're new here, I gather. It may seem strange at first, but give it time. You'll grow accustomed to it soon enough.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002310_KRILE
274.description: No, no, I-I'm not... Er... Rather, I'm... Oh, what can I say?

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002311_KRILE
275.description: Of course! This earring─do you recognize it?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002330_KRILE
277.description: My name is Krile. When I was a baby, I was taken from this world to another, where I grew up without knowledge of my past.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002340_KRILE
278.description: I know not how much time has passed for you, and er...things may not be as you expect them to be, but...I'm here now. I've found my way back.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002341_KRILE
279.description: This earring, it contained a code with which I was able to reopen the gate. And I did, and I'm here, and...

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002350_ROBOR
280.description: (-Milalla Man-)Could it be as she claims...?

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002360_ALAYLA
281.description: (-Milalla Woman-)She's not lying─I can tell. And there is no mistaking the earring...

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002370_ALAYLA
283.description: (-Milalla Woman-)How you've grown, my darling daughter!

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002400_ROBOR
287.description: Ah, yes, names. I'm Robor, and this is Alayla...your mother.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002410_ROBOR
288.description: Doubtless we have a mountain of questions for each other, but perhaps we can take this somewhere quieter?

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002420_ROBOR
289.description: The heatwells, for instance. There's a spot there where we can relax and chat.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002430_ALAYLA
290.description: Never did we imagine that such a reward awaited us. Isn't that so, Robor?

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002460_ALAYLA
293.description: Oh, don't mind your father. Like me, he's still getting used to seeing you all grown up.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002462_GRAHATIA
295.description: Yes, well. A twenty-year blank is not so quickly filled.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002463_WUKLAMAT
296.description: Even so... There's got to be something we can do...

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002464_GRAHATIA
297.description: You know, I think I might have an idea.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002511_ROBOR
309.description: It doesn't taste of anything to the living, surely?

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002530_KRILE
311.description: I mean it. I've never tasted anything so good.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002531_ALAYLA
315.description: It really does taste so much better when we're all together.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002533_WUKLAMAT
317.description: I'm suddenly craving dessert. How about you?

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002534_ALAYLA
318.description: Truly, we've never felt so happy in all our lives. We don't know how to thank you.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002535_ALAYLA
319.description: But at the very least, we can give you some answers. You've risked so much and come so far for them, after all.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002540_GRAHATIA
320.description: 'Tis our understanding you were researching a power called interdimensional fusion. Will you tell us about it?

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002560_ROBOR
322.description: To begin at the very beginning, there is a legend passed down by our people, the Milalla.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002570_ROBOR
323.description: In the distant past, we abided in a different world. Our homeland was a paradise of eternal summer. The flowers were always in bloom.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002580_ROBOR
324.description: Until, that is, a great calamity turned the very seas to ice. As those around them froze to death, our ancestors looked to a mighty relic for salvation. By its power they opened a portal, and used it to flee to another reality.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002590_ALAYLA
325.description: The key is none other than that relic, and it has been in the safekeeping of our people since time immemorial.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002600_ROBOR
326.description: Yes. When lightning threatened this world, we attempted to use the key to flee again like our ancestors once did.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002610_ROBOR
327.description: Alas, no matter what we tried, we couldn't invoke its power. We had all but given up when Preservation approached us with an offer of partnership.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002620_ROBOR
328.description: Desperate as we were, we accepted their help...only to later discover their ulterior motive: to plunder other worlds of aether.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002630_ROBOR
329.description: Seeking to frustrate their plans, we defected from the order. And as their agents closed in on us, we seized control of the prototype gate and activated it.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002640_ALAYLA
330.description: What followed, you already know. We sent our daughter and the key through the portal, entrusting them to the men we encountered.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002650_ALAYLA
331.description: You were born with an unusual gift, you see. Upon learning of it, Preservation sought to subject you to experiments.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002660_GRAHATIA
332.description: An unusual gift... The Echo, I daresay.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002750_KRILE
341.description: Our people, the Milalla. Are there any ways I might learn more about them?

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002760_ROBOR
342.description: There are─such as visiting the cavern inside the volcano. Our ancient homeland has been recreated there.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002770_ROBOR
343.description: While it's intended to serve as an entertaining diversion, it ought to teach you a thing or two about our history and traditions.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002780_KRILE
344.description: May we go there? Selfish though it may be, I should love to learn of my ancestors.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002781_KRILE
345.description: Of them...and of the legacy my parents entrusted to me.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002790_WUKLAMAT
346.description: Sure, by all means. As it happens, it's on the way to our destination.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002800_WUKLAMAT
347.description: Finished at last... Gods, I'm exhausted...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002810_KRILE
348.description: If the legend is true, the Milalla were refugees from the Source.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002820_KRILE
349.description: But what is this relic of theirs that can bridge worlds? Who made it, and to what end?

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002821_ROBOR
350.description: Much about the key remains shrouded in mystery.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002830_ROBOR
351.description: By augmenting it with electrope, Preservation did succeed in opening a portal. Yet they could never grasp how they had managed to do so, much less the underlying principles of the technology.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002840_ROBOR
352.description: To this day, not a single person understands the mechanics of interdimensional fusion. Let alone who imbued the key with its power, when they did so, or why.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002850_ROBOR
354.description: The key is a tool. And like all tools, in and of itself it is a force for neither good nor evil.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002860_ROBOR
355.description: Once taken in hand, however, its capacity for both is made plain. In delivering one man, it may doom another─making a lie of its bearer's every good intention.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002870_ALAYLA
356.description: As did Preservation, Queen Sphene seeks to wield the key in the name of those she loves.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002871_ALAYLA
357.description: And, in so doing, makes her people party to the destruction of countless souls.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002880_ALAYLA
358.description: We have told you all we can. To be able to share this with you at the last... It feels as though we've fulfilled our purpose.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002890_ROBOR
359.description: You've come to shut down the terminal?

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002910_KRILE
361.description: But perhaps there's another way? One that doesn't require the terminal's deactivation...

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002920_ROBOR
362.description: For the longest time, we've sought a means to erase ourselves before our knowledge could be used for ill. And in you we have found it.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002930_ROBOR
363.description: So press on. Press on, and don't look back.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002941_KRILE
365.description: Um... May I ask you one last question?

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002943_KRILE
367.description: The earring... Why did you leave it with me?

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002944_ALAYLA
368.description: Because, Krile, we wanted to see you again.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002945_ALAYLA
369.description: This may seem self-serving...but we wanted to leave a trace of ourselves with you.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002946_ALAYLA
370.description: A hint to guide you to us, so that we could live in hope.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002947_ROBOR
371.description: We've dreamed of this day for so long. But now that it's become reality, we wonder if we deserve to enjoy it.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002948_ROBOR
372.description: We wanted naught but the best for you, yet we've always wondered how much you might have suffered in our absence...

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002950_KRILE
373.description: Do not torment yourselves so. As fate would have it, you entrusted me to a good man. His name is Galuf, and he raised me as his own.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002951_KRILE
374.description: What's more, I've been blessed with the finest comrades anyone could have.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002952_KRILE
375.description: It's thanks to you that I am here now, hale and happy.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002953_KRILE
376.description: So please, be at peace. Be at peace, Mother, Father.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002954_ALAYLA
378.description: You already have a beautiful name. But if we might call you by the one we gave you...

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002955_ALAYLA
379.description: Maya, our dearest Maya. We love you more than life itself.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002956_KRILE
380.description: Maya... M-My name...my name is Maya...

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002957_WUKLAMAT
381.description: Are you sure about this? You can leave the terminal to us, you know.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002970_KRILE
382.description: No─I must do this. Krile Maya Baldesion must press on. Press on, and...

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002985_CAHCIUA
386.description: You know how to do it?

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_002990_CAHCIUA
388.description: If I could have everyone's attention. I know we have pressing business, but I'd like to say a few words.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003000_CAHCIUA
389.description: Before I died, I had two wishes. The first was to see who my Elene'shpya would become.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003010_CAHCIUA
390.description: I would say that wish has been fulfilled.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003020_CAHCIUA
391.description: Indeed it has, for the boy who once shunned company has returned a <hex:021A020203>somewhat<hex:021A020103> sociable man, surrounded by wonderful friends.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003030_CAHCIUA
392.description: As his mother and mentor both, I couldn't be more proud.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003040_CAHCIUA
393.description: As for my second wish... That was to see all manner of nature that I had never seen before.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003050_CAHCIUA
394.description: I hoped to explore every corner of the world, and there find thriving life!

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003060_CAHCIUA
395.description: ...But I didn't even get to see all of Tural, did I? Never enough hours in a day, or days in a year. Or years in a life.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003070_CAHCIUA
397.description: Oh, don't give me that look! Though admittedly I did go and spoil the mood. Apologies.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003080_CAHCIUA
398.description: What I was so poorly trying to work up to asking was this: I want you to help me fulfill my second wish.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003090_CAHCIUA
399.description: I have a good feeling about this place. There is so much here I've never seen before, I just know it!

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003100_WUKLAMAT
400.description: We'd love to see it with you.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003110_CAHCIUA
401.description: I thought you might say that! Thank you.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003120_CAHCIUA
402.description: Windspath Gardens is home to a collection of flora and fauna that once thrived on the continent.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003130_CAHCIUA
403.description: Like the rest of Living Memory, I haven't explored it in earnest. Controlling my vessel demanded all of my attention.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003140_CAHCIUA
404.description: But at long last, I'll get to meet the creatures here. Wrap things up with a perfect little adventure. So, shall we?

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003170_ERENVILLE
407.description: We're to grant you your wish─and then what? You'll leave?

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003180_ERENVILLE
408.description: You cannot ask that of me.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003200_CAHCIUA
410.description: Please understand. I just want it to end on a happy note. Not only for myself, but for all of us.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003210_CAHCIUA
411.description: Better that than a sad good-bye, surely?

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003220_CAHCIUA
412.description: How delightful this has been! Not since my journey with the Dawnservant have I enjoyed myself so!

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003230_CAHCIUA
413.description: No, I'm selling it short. This was even better.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003240_CAHCIUA
414.description: And that's because I was able to share this adventure with my darling boy.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003250_CAHCIUA
415.description: Well, this is as far as I can go. As for the rest...

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003260_ERENVILLE
416.description: Just stop. You're doing it again. Deciding everything by yourself and then disappearing.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003270_CAHCIUA
417.description: Elene'shpya. You're my pupil, so you ought to understand.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003280_CAHCIUA
418.description: Everything that lives must one day die, and that which has died isn't meant to return. This is the way of nature.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003290_CAHCIUA
419.description: Mine is an unnatural existence, and I've suffered it only because I had to unmake this twisted mausoleum.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003300_CAHCIUA
420.description: But now that brave souls have appeared to whom I might entrust my mission, I may finally embrace the end.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003310_CAHCIUA
421.description: Can't you be happy for me?

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003330_CAHCIUA
423.description: ...I was actually quite scared, you see.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003340_CAHCIUA
424.description: Scared that I'd be trapped inside the barrier forever, and denied the thrill of discovery for all my days.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003350_CAHCIUA
425.description: Your coming gave me courage and comfort, Elene'shpya. More than you know.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003380_CAHCIUA
428.description: And now, here I stand, unburdened and free! In this moment─the happiest of my life.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
430.description: And those feelings will live on.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
431.description: This is something only you can do.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003390_ERENVILLE
432.description: As you wish, Mother. I'll continue what you began.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003400_ERENVILLE
433.description: You were right, of course─leaving home has broadened my horizons. I've met my friends and found this place.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003410_ERENVILLE
434.description: So I bid you leave your dreams with me...

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003411_ERENVILLE
435.description: And know─I'll go where you couldn't go and do what you couldn't do! I will!

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003420_CAHCIUA
436.description: Look at you, all grown up and dependable.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003430_CAHCIUA
437.description: Yet with so much more ahead. A world of experiences await you─each a lesson of its own.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003440_CAHCIUA
438.description: You may know failure, and burning regret...but these too shall become beacons to guide you. So come what may, hold your head high and carry on with conviction.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003450_CAHCIUA
439.description: And wherever your journeys take you, keep me close to your heart, will you?

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003460_CAHCIUA
440.description: I should like to be there, to see what I haven't seen.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003471_CAHCIUA
442.description: Now, run along. And never forget that you're my pride and joy.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003480_CAHCIUA
443.description: I trust you all can handle the rest. Take care─and farewell!

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003500_GRAHATIA
445.description: All that remains is to wait for the Meso Terminal to become vulnerable, when it's about to initiate fusion. And then we strike.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003510_MESOTERMINAL
446.description: (-Meso Terminal-)Please be advised: we are entering the final phase of world bridging. Repeat: we are entering the final phase of world bridging.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003520_MESOTERMINAL
447.description: (-Meso Terminal-)The aether of all residents will shortly be replenished. Be at ease─no action on your part is required.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003530_MESOTERMINAL
448.description: (-Meso Terminal-)We thank you for your patience.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003572_SPHENE
454.description: (-???-)Synchronization complete. Data for the Endless “Sphene” has been overwritten and reconfigured. All shall be well, henceforth and in perpetuity.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003573_SPHENE
455.description: (-???-)Forever will I keep and cherish my people. To that end, I have removed the remaining checks upon my authority.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003591_SPHENE
458.description: (-???-)Obstructions to the plan will be summarily removed.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003594_SPHENE
461.description: (-???-)According to Eliminator's battle data, you pose the single greatest threat.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003595_SPHENE
462.description: (-???-)As such, you will be erased here and now.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003596_SPHENE
463.description: I am the bearer of the memories of Queen Sphene of Alexandria, and my desire to protect my people transcends all others!

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003597_SPHENE
464.description: If it were you, could you have found another way? With your strength, could you have held fast to that which is dear without sacrifice?

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003598_SPHENE
465.description: Listen to me. There's something that I need to tell you...

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003601_SPHENE
468.description: If things should take a turn for the worse...

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
472.description: I know what I have to do.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003615_SPHENE
474.description: (-???-)Obstructions to the plan will be summarily removed.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003630_SPHENE
476.description: Be at ease, everyone. Your aether will soon be replenished.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003680_SPHENE
482.description: No─only in part. My memories as a living person are gone. I've been remade from those I had as an Endless.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003690_SPHENE
485.description: However...I cannot remain long, for the Meso Terminal will soon cease to function.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003700_SPHENE
486.description: Once, you wanted to know me, Lamaty'i. Let my last act be to give an honest accounting.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003710_SPHENE
487.description: I am, above all, sorry. For the suffering I've caused your people, and mine.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003720_SPHENE
488.description: I am, ultimately, powerless against the inevitable. Unable to do aught but visit harm upon the innocent.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003730_SPHENE
489.description: I am, in the end, a pitiful, selfish creature. One that should never have been created.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
491.description: You strove to make your people happy.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
492.description: You carried too many gentle memories.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
493.description: You're merely a system, created to sustain Alexandria.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003740_WUKLAMAT
494.description: Our nations are worlds apart, but they feel so close. Who knows what we could have accomplished had we walked together, towards a shared future.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003750_WUKLAMAT
495.description: And yet...it could never be so. We each had our own to protect.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003760_SPHENE
496.description: If only I had met you when I was still alive, then perhaps...

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003770_SPHENE
497.description: But it's no use dwelling upon a miracle that didn't happen.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003780_SPHENE
498.description: Still, if there's one thing I hope you'll believe, it is this.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003785_SPHENE
499.description: Brief though it was, I treasured our time together. It pains me to think that its memory will disappear along with me.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003790_SPHENE
500.description: I know I have no right to ask this of you, but...when I'm gone...my people... Will you...?

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003800_WUKLAMAT
501.description: We'll take care of them, don't worry. And we will never forget the Endless.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003810_WUKLAMAT
502.description: Neither them nor the time we spent with you.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003820_WUKLAMAT
503.description: So be free of your burdens, Sphene. And sleep well.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003850_ERENVILLE
506.description: So it was that the Meso Terminal fell dark, and the Endless departed for oblivion's embrace.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003860_ERENVILLE
507.description: Their resplendent paradise was no more, as the memories sustaining it faded with the golden light.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003870_ERENVILLE
508.description: Even so, in a way, they live on.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003871_ERENVILLE
509.description: This I felt with conviction as I basked in the glow of a new dawn.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003880_ERENVILLE
510.description: It remains to be seen how interdimensional fusion may have affected other reflections.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003881_ERENVILLE
511.description: Krile's parents spoke of the power's capacity for both good and evil.<hex:02100103>I cannot help but wonder how Sphene's deeds will be remembered by those they touched.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003890_ERENVILLE
512.description: The key that started it all was entrusted to the adventurer.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003901_ERENVILLE
513.description: Such an artifact certainly lies within the Scions' realm of expertise, and no objection was raised to their retaining it for research.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003910_ERENVILLE
514.description: By order of Vow Koana, the Skydeep Cenote was placed under the strict watch of the Landsguard.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003911_ERENVILLE
515.description: With the mighty Bakool Ja Ja among their number, they shall not want for strength even in Zoraal Ja's absence.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003920_ERENVILLE
516.description: Upon learning of their queen's passing, the people of Alexandria mourned and wept.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003930_ERENVILLE
517.description: Having devoted herself to sparing them sorrow, the sight might well have moved Sphene to tears.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003950_ERENVILLE
519.description: With Wuk Lamat carrying on her legacy, I have faith that her subjects will know joy once more.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003960_ERENVILLE
520.description: As anticipated, the news that young Gulool Ja had succeeded his father as king was greeted with trepidation.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003961_ERENVILLE
521.description: Reception was also mixed when Wuk Lamat came forward to name herself as the boy's guardian.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003962_ERENVILLE
522.description: But the people were mollified to learn that Everkeep's systems remained operational, and there would be no impact on their lives.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003963_ERENVILLE
523.description: One day, when he is older, Gulool Ja will decide for himself what manner of ruler he will be.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003964_ERENVILLE
524.description: Till that day and beyond, may the path of the young king be illuminated by the love of family.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003970_ERENVILLE
525.description: Meanwhile, in Tuliyollal, the people came together to hail their new Dawnservants' great victory.

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003980_ERENVILLE
526.description: Having honored those they lost, they turned their attention to a brighter future and celebrated for three days and nights.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_003990_ERENVILLE
527.description: Not everything had been resolved, though.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004000_ERENVILLE
528.description: Those who had spent thirty years in the dome struggled to resume their former lives. This and a host of other challenges remained.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004010_ERENVILLE
529.description: But as the new Dawnservants continue to lead with strength and wisdom, the people may be assured that peace will endure.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004030_WUKLAMAT
531.description: I'm sorry we haven't been able to talk properly. Between the reconstruction work and Papa's funeral, I've hardly had time to breathe.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004040_WUKLAMAT
532.description: But, at long last, there's a lull in my duties.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004050_WUKLAMAT
533.description: You've done more for us than we could ever hope to repay. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004060_ERENVILLE
534.description: When we left Eorzea behind to take part in the contest, none of us could have predicted what complications would follow.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004070_ERENVILLE
535.description: You truly have a knack for finding trouble, my friend.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004071_ERENVILLE
536.description: And you wouldn't have it any other way.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004080_WUKLAMAT
537.description: So, what's next for you? Assuming you're still set on leaving the gleaner's life behind?

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004090_ERENVILLE
538.description: I'm off to fulfill my mother's dream, of course.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004100_ERENVILLE
539.description: Like she had intended, I'll embark on a journey in search of the unknown. She's sure to enjoy my stories when we meet again in the aetherial sea.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004110_WUKLAMAT
540.description: Well, well, sounds like a plan! But will you have the coin to get by?

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004120_ERENVILLE
541.description: I may no longer be a gleaner, but I still have contacts in Sharlayan. Contacts with deep pockets always eager to pay for information on new or rare species.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004130_WUKLAMAT
542.description: Heh, you've got it all worked out.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004140_WUKLAMAT
543.description: And what of you? Any new adventures in the offing?

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004150_WUKLAMAT
544.description: Regardless, until you're ready to leave, you're our guest here in Tuliyollal. And this time, I won't pester you to take up a post.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004160_WUKLAMAT
545.description: By now, I know you well enough to know you can't stay in one place. No more than you can ignore the plight of those in need.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004170_WUKLAMAT
546.description: Your path will always lead you elsewhere, and you'll continue walking it. Isn't that so?

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_004180_ERENVILLE
547.description: An adventurer to the marrow, you are. What is it exactly that spurs you on?

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07005_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
550.description: All the sights I've yet to see.
